name: swoltracker
description: AI-powered workout tracking — log sets, track PRs, generate programs, and monitor progress.
author: SnappyClaw

events.name: swoltracker.pr_detected
events.description: Emitted when a user sets a new personal record on any exercise

events.name: swoltracker.workout_completed
events.description: Emitted when a user marks a workout day as complete

events.name: swoltracker.streak_at_risk
events.description: Emitted when a user's workout streak is at risk of breaking (future)

events.name: swoltracker.weekly_summary_ready
events.description: Emitted at end of week with compiled stats (future)
